revision_reasons: The stock 7B explicit JSON public20 development pilot produced zero usable attempts out of four. Two patches passed finite external oracles, so this is a workflow outcome rather than proof that every patch was behaviorally wrong.

Earlier stock native 4B development traces include a genuinely usable SKU task with a fresh executed check and three external behavioral test methods. This supports screening the native 4B stack, not general autonomy, overall benchmark success or specialists superiority.

Generic development-only fixes preserve raw source text and guidance, retain a bounded transient planner cue, resolve trusted installed Python console scripts, distinguish pytest no-tests exit status, and bound repeated/no-op workflow attempts. JSON final instructions now ask for actual phase content instead of a literal example placeholder; the selected 4B protocol remains native.
Cache zero, prefill 256 and 1.0 GiB minimum headroom are explicit screened resource settings. They do not establish autonomous task quality or a total-memory guarantee.
Synthetic_v2 prompts, fixtures, reference facts and external oracles remain frozen. No synthetic_v2 model inference has occurred according to root; none was requested by the draft author.

Public21 synthetic_v1 screening recorded repeated 768-token length-limited responses, print-only check activity and a reviewer loop exhausting the shared call budget; diagnosis is from root development-trace review, not synthetic_v2 outcomes.

The final generic transient coder/reviewer cues restate role, already-charged shared/role counters, numeric recorded check status and phase completion format. They preserve original objectives, corrections and paired evidence without claiming semantic success or source freshness. Read-only summaries must answer the original question with observed file references.

The frozen generic assertion guidance requires checks meaningful to requested behavior and distinguishes them from prints/import-only commands. Existing actual-read, validation freshness, permissions and reviewer decision gates remain enforced.

The final output allowance is 2048 tokens for every mode and role, under the same 24-call/600-second global limits and 14000-character history budget. No further configuration or source tuning is planned after public22; freeze this explicit amendment before any synthetic_v2 request.

Completed final public22 screening supports choosing the sole native 4B stack after the unreliable 7B development workflows, while retaining explicit limitations: single usable/oracle 1 of 2; specialists usable 0 of 2 and oracle 1 of 2; all four graded, zero timeouts or resource aborts. This is a fixed workflow comparison, not a claim of dependable quality.
design: Exactly one stock model and one trial per case/workflow; no adapter, retrieval memory or decision router. All specialists share the identical model weights.

Same frozen suite/runtime/tool contract, output 2048/context 14000 and explicit global 24-call/600-second caps in both workflows. Each role is capped at 24 calls within the shared global cap; phase limits do not add calls to it.
Both suite call and timeout defaults are explicitly overridden. Cases run independently from unchanged fixture state; neither task histories nor reference material enter memory or training.
Paired order alternates AB/BA; one model server and one task/request execute at a time. Prompt caching is disabled; its byte setting is recorded without claiming an enforced aggregate memory cap.
No adaptive v1 outcomes are pooled with v2. Preserve the exact original 80-attempt plan and its hash before promoting this 40-attempt amendment.
Oracles and bounded inspection facts remain frozen. Independent CPU review of actual final answers, patches, observed reads, meaningful checks and their freshness follows the full comparison.
Resource guard stops preserve attempted, graded, ungraded and unstarted counts. Case timeout prevents additional requests until external backend idleness can be confirmed.
Verify complete source hash map and frozen suite fingerprint before and after inference; raw checkpoints remain outside the repository.
This measures public stock model/workflow behavior on small synthetic tasks, not training gain, independently trained expert models, commercial-agent parity or broad real-project reliability.

post_registration_policy: Preserve this registration and original archive by exact content hash before the first fresh case request; record both references in the comparison metadata.
Do not tune runtime, model, protocol, prompts, fixtures, oracles or scoring after held-out outcomes. Do not replace this fixed-profile comparison with new models or settings.
Use the same frozen 26-file runtime hash map, pinned weights and explicit budgets in both workflows; execute every task from independent unchanged fixture state.
If resource guard or unconfirmed backend idleness stops the run, retain honest attempted, graded, ungraded and unstarted counts; do not silently repeat-select successful attempts.
Audit actual final answers, patches, observed reads and meaningful checks with CPU-only evidence after evaluation, keeping raw checkpoints outside the public tree.
